title: mybasename
summary: basename(1): the last component of a path, with an optional suffix removed.
hints: Copy the argument to a buffer (never write into `argv`), cut the trailing `/` characters off (but keep a path that is only `/`) and take what follows `strrchr(path, '/')`.
Remove the suffix only if it is shorter than the name and `strcmp(name + strlen(name) - strlen(suffix), suffix) == 0`.
